name: EPIC 206108556
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 11.8 solar radii and 1.50 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206108556 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.769851 (16th-84th percentiles 11.386476-12.340769), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206108556 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.497276 (16th-84th percentiles 1.396592-1.676093), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206108556: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4683.4614 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206108556 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1541.386719 (16th-84th percentiles 1504.550781-1593.691406), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.11 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,541 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.50 solar masses and 11.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,683 K at its surface.
